headline: Stock exchange. Romanians subscribed to 1.3 billion lei of Fidelis government bonds in October. Over 75% of the amount went to euro-denominated issues, which have the highest interest rates so far
summary: Investors subscribed to 1.3 billion lei of Fidelis government bonds in the October offering, with over 75% of the amount going to euro-denominated issues.
why: Government bond demand indicates investor appetite for sovereign debt, and euro-denominated issues affect the state's currency exposure and borrowing costs.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Bursă. Românii au subscris titluri de stat Fidelis de 1,3 mld. lei în octombrie. Peste 75% din sumă a mers către emisiunile în euro, având cele mai ridicate dobânzi de până acum
